tasks.title: Resolve exact rows and identifier/count anomalies
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Every defining page and ambiguous/uncoded row has evidence-bound disposition; all 22 overlapping cases decided or explicitly excluded with qualified rationale.

tasks.title: Finish global goals and supplementary overlap
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Global/national/institutional/subject goals and all applicable support content have reviewed scope; examples, nested items and duplicate appearances remain distinct from unique requirements.

tasks.title: Reconcile source versions, newer notices and cohorts
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Current official notices receive content/applicability review; older batches and legacy modules are separated; amendments are bound to exact source and intended cohort.

tasks.title: Obtain qualified source and clinical acceptance
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Verified qualified reviewer accepts exact versions and interpretations; AI investigation is not recorded as independent clinical approval.

tasks.title: Resolve intended-use rights
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Evidence establishes rights for intended storage/display/reuse; citation-only source observations do not authorize bulk reproduction.

tasks.title: Bind accepted requirements to canonical concepts
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Accepted exact requirements connect to existing canonical Medical Knowledge Graph identities without duplicate taxonomy or competency-to-mastery equivalence.

tasks.title: Review NEET-PG and INI-CET overlays
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Each exam scope has independent reviewed mappings and uncertainty; NMC undergraduate scope is not equated to entrance examination weighting.

tasks.title: Integrate approved versioned curriculum registry
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Exact approved objective/mapping/artifact versions enter existing registry through authenticated reviewed flow with version history and fail-closed eligibility.

tasks.title: Verify actual authorized Admin review flow
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Actual authorized Admin stages/reviews exact accepted material and verifies authorization, duplicate handling, corrections and audit evidence.

tasks.title: Verify actual learner syllabus and study flow
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Learner sees only authorized mapped content, honest coverage/unknowns and valid Study Now behavior; device flows and isolation pass on exact candidate.

tasks.title: Consolidate dependency stack and stage exact candidate
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Dependency-ordered draft work is integrated with current main; CI, migrations and staging checks pass on the exact release candidate; rollback is verified.

tasks.title: Approve release and verify production
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Owner authorizes concrete reviewed candidate release; production version, access, learner behavior and rollback checks are recorded.
